8058.title: Workflow selection skips per-model reasoning discovery
8058.rootCauseOneLine: Workflow validation and worker selection do not refine unknown model reasoning capabilities before rejecting an explicit level or replacing an inherited level with the default.
8058.proposedFix: Expose the selected-model SDK argument and refine unknown models before workflow validation and runtime selection; define failure behavior explicitly.
8058.caveats: Two clean workflow-boundary reproductions with a simulated SDK catalog, not a live ACP or desktop reproduction. The complete regression patch and actual output are inline in the report. Existing open PR 8059 links this issue, so no duplicate fix was attempted.
